subject: AWS co-sell: bridge request + joint sprint for Marketplace listing
messages:
From: Priya Natarajan <priya@redwood.com>
To: Sanjay Rao <sanjay@acmehealth.com>
Cc: Karthik Iyer <karthik@redwood.com>, Vanessa Ortiz <vanessa@redwood.com>
Date: Mon, 21 Jun 2027 09:12:00 -0700
Subject: AWS co-sell: bridge request + joint sprint for Marketplace listing

Hi Sanjay —

Thanks again for a great intro last week. Acme Health’s platform fit looks promising and the AWS Marketplace route should materially shorten procurement. We’d like to request an AWS co-sell bridge intro (to the field/partner team) and run a focused 2-week joint sprint to get the Marketplace listing and co-sell readiness over the line.

Proposed scope for the sprint:
- Canonical listing copy + pricing model guidance
- Security/compliance checklist (SOC 2 evidence & data residency notes)
- Demo cadence and customer reference plan
- Procurement touchpoints and DocuSign readiness

Can you share the best contact on the AWS account team for a 30-min intro? If helpful, we can include an early MAM (attached) so the AWS PM sees the proposed milestones.

Available windows for a 30-min sync this week: Tue 2–4pm PT, Wed 10–11am PT, Thu 9–11am PT. Let me know what works or send a meeting invite.

Thanks — looking forward to moving fast on this.

— Priya
Priya Natarajan
Platform Sales, Redwood Inference
priya@redwood.com | +1 (415) 555-0147

Hi Priya —

Thanks, this looks useful. I can get you to our AWS field rep; cc'ing Lena who owns partnerships/marketplace at Acme. Lena — meet Priya, Karthik and Vanessa from Redwood.

For the 30-minute intro, Wed 10:00am PT works for me. If that works for your team, please send a calendar invite and include an agenda.

Also looping in Procurement (procurement@acmehealth.com) early so we can flag any licensing/contract constraints.

Best,
Sanjay
Sanjay Rao
Head of Platform, Acme Health

Date: Mon, 21 Jun 2027 12:40:00 -07:00

Thanks Sanjay — great to meet you, Lena. Wed 10am PT works for the Redwood crew. Proposed 30-min agenda:
1) Quick intros (5 min)
2) Sprint goals & timelines (8 min)
3) AWS field role + co-sell mechanics (10 min)
4) Procurement milestones & next steps (5 min)

I attached a short checklist we use for Marketplace readiness — should help the AWS PM evaluate the initial gap.

— Vanessa
Vanessa Ortiz
Partner Sales, Redwood Inference
vanessa@redwood.com

From: Karthik Iyer <karthik@redwood.com>

Date: Tue, 22 Jun 2027 09:05:00 -07:00
Subject: Re: AWS co-sell: bridge request + joint sprint for Marketplace listing

Appreciate the quick turnaround. A few notes before the intro: 
- We should confirm the target SKU/pricing band for the listing; Priya, Vanessa — can you propose 2 pricing flavors (consumption, annual commit) before Wed?
- Security ask: Acme, can you confirm which SOC 2 report year you need (2025 vs 2026)? We have both but want to make sure the right artifact is shared.
- AWS field: if the rep can join the sprint kickoff we can align roles (field -> enablement -> procurement).

I assigned a short pre-read (MAM + checklist) to the Drive link so everyone can review ahead of Wed.

Thanks — Karthik
Karthik Iyer
Head of Partnerships, Redwood Inference
From: Lena Ortiz <lena.ortiz@acmehealth.com>
To: Karthik Iyer <karthik@redwood.com>, Priya Natarajan <priya@redwood.com>, Vanessa Ortiz <vanessa@redwood.com>, Sanjay Rao <sanjay@acmehealth.com>, procurement@acmehealth.com
Date: Wed, 23 Jun 2027 15:40:00 -07:00
Subject: Re: AWS co-sell: bridge request + joint sprint for Marketplace listing

Thanks everyone — confirmed for Wed 10am PT, and I invited our AWS field rep, Mark Chu (mark.chu@amazon.com). Procurement is aware and will review the pricing flavors from Redwood. A couple of asks prior to the call:
- Priya/Vanessa: please upload the SKU + sample contract language so procurement can pre-flag any clauses.
- Karthik: please include expected timeline for listing review and any manual AWS checks that typically add time.

We’ll treat this as an operational bridge — if all looks good, procurement expects to start internal review within 5 business days after the sprint kickoff.

See you on Wed — Lena
Lena Ortiz
Dir, Partnerships, Acme Health
